fields.description:
As a maintainer, I want the two-tier-flow UX defects fixed and the documentation/ADR brought current so that the enforced architecture is correctly described and the merge-to-main UX is clean.

Plan refs: A-7 (UX fixes — independent of the enforce-flip, may land any time); A-6 (docs + validation + closure). Includes the review-#4 re-baseline note.

DONE DEFINITION:
- DD1 (A-7 PR1 titles): merge-to-main-pr.sh:938-939 PR1 title is derived from the branch's meaningful commit subject (reuse _derive_pr_title, the helper PR2 already uses) with the staged: prefix retained; TDD asserts the gh pr create --title argv for PR1 is descriptive, not the branch-arrow form. Live: a throwaway promotion's PR1 shows a descriptive title. (SC6)
- DD2 (A-7 draft umbrella): create-sprint-draft-pr.sh gets a descriptive title/body and its lifecycle closes the draft at sprint end (or documents why long-lived); the script is RETAINED (two-tier flow kept). (SC6)
- DD3 (re-baseline): before touching merge-to-main-pr.sh, re-run the per-file rollback/preserve guard against CURRENT origin/main (it has moved beyond the plan snapshot — e.g. this session's CONFLICTING fast-fail and empty-state PR discovery commits). (SC6)
- DD4 (docs): update WORKFLOW-STABILITY-CHECKS.md, contracts/review-defenses.md, runbooks/rulesets-rollback.md, HOOKS-REFERENCE.md, CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md, workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md (Step 0.5 local gate), INSTALL.md, CLAUDE.md, CI-INTEGRATION.md, and teach check-ruleset-preflight.sh about review-gate. (SC6)
- DD5 (ADR + closure): record the execution results (E-series outcomes, the E1 per-SHA semantics, the E7 GO/fallback decision) in ADR-0020; run the completion-verifier for every epic SC; close the epic only on verifier PASS.

LIVE VERIFICATION: a full two-tier promotion through the enforced summary gate completes clean (the canonical end-to-end demonstration).

COURSE-CORRECTION TRIGGER: if the completion-verifier cannot confirm any SC against the implementation, do NOT close — open a remediation story.

Maps to SC6 (+ verifies SC1-SC5 at closure). A-7 portion independent; A-6 portion is the final closure step.
